meta.creative_rules: Bold event announcement. Date and time prominent. Urgency design elements. CTA to register or attend.

instagram.creative_rules: Eye-catching event graphic. Date/time bold. Consistent brand aesthetics. Swipe for details.

tiktok.creative_rules: Exciting event teaser. Countdown energy. Bold text reveals.

facebook.creative_rules: Event banner quality. Share-worthy announcement. RSVP CTA.

pinterest.creative_rules: Seasonal event pin. Aspirational event visual.

x.creative_rules: Bold announcement graphic. Date prominent. Event details clear.

general.master_prompt: Design a bold event promotion graphic for {{ .Title }}. Vibrant eye-catching background with gradient or bold colors. Large bold event headline text. Date, time, and location details clearly displayed. {{ .Description }}. Urgency or excitement design elements (countdown, stars, confetti, or bold shapes). Clear CTA like 'Register Now', 'Save the Date', 'Don't Miss Out'. Professional event marketing quality.
general.video_prompt: Event promo video for {{ .Title }}. Exciting reveal. Bold date/time text animations. Urgency countdown. CTA at end. {{ .Description }}.
general.carousel_prompt: Event details carousel for {{ .Title }}. Slide 1: Bold event announcement with date. Slide 2: What to expect / speakers / lineup. Slide 3: Venue or platform details. Slide 4: Registration CTA. {{ .Description }}. Consistent vibrant design.

platform_adaptation.meta: Bold announcement banner. Date prominent. Register CTA.
platform_adaptation.instagram: Eye-catching event card. Swipe for details.

general.product_rule: event details front and center, urgency elements, bold design

fashion_apparel.master_prompt: Design a bold fashion event or launch graphic for {{ .Title }}. Dramatic design with bold typography. Collection drop or flash sale announcement. Date and time prominent. {{ .Description }}. Exclusive feel with limited time urgency. Bold CTA. Fashion campaign quality.
fashion_apparel.video_prompt: Fashion launch teaser for {{ .Title }}. Dramatic reveal. Bold date text. Exclusive feel. CTA. {{ .Description }}.
fashion_apparel.carousel_prompt: Fashion launch carousel for {{ .Title }}. Slide 1: Bold drop announcement. Slide 2: Preview teaser. Slide 3: Date and time. Slide 4: CTA to shop. {{ .Description }}.
fashion_apparel.product_rule: event/launch excitement, date prominent, exclusive feel
